column2: ## Run within "thread-strength.Rproj" so here::here() resolves to the analysis root.
install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()]            # select missing packages
for (lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib, dependencies = TRUE)     # install missing + deps
sapply(load.lib, require, character = TRUE)                             # load all packages
